routes.name: Treaty of Peace and Friendship (India–Nepal, 1950), Article 7

note: Nepal, read on 2026-10-30 in the 1950 Treaty of Peace and Friendship between India and Nepal, in the Indian Ministry of External Affairs' copy (rendered in a browser; drawn by script): Article 7 grants each country's nationals the same privileges in residence, property, trade and movement in the other, read as free movement for Indian nationals in Nepal. Others need a work permit from the Department of Labour under the Labour Act 2074 and a non-tourist visa from the Department of Immigration; the Department of Immigration's site didn't answer this client and the legal site carrying the Act sits behind a bot check, so no work, permanent or other route is written.

sources.title: Ministry of External Affairs (India), Treaty of Peace and Friendship between India and Nepal (1950)
sources.said: Article 7 The Governments of India and Nepal agree to grant, on reciprocal basis, to the nationals of one country in the territories o the other the same privileges in the matter of residence
